Ireland 20-17 South Africa: Springboks downed as Andy Farrell's side hold on for big victory in Nations Championship
Last Updated: 21/11/26 6:52pm
Robert Baloucoune's brace of tries saw Ireland seal a huge 20-17 victory against South Africa in the Nations Championship.
A trio of first-half tries helped Andy Farrell's side outlast the Springboks, with Ronan Kelleher touching down before half-time after Baloucoune's double inside the opening 20 minutes.
Without their head coach Rassie Erasmus, who was banned for six matches after criticising officials following his side's defeat to France, South Africa went into the break seven points adrift following a late try from Morne van den Berg.
They surged late into the match, with Malcolm Marx crossing on 58 minutes to set up a tense finish.
Despite a barrage of South Africa attacks, Ireland's defence was resolute, with Farrell's side moving above France to second in the Northern Hemisphere standings, with Les Bleus playing Argentina later on Saturday.
